What if you wore flip flops every day?
Flip flops are one of the most popular shoes in summer. They're easy and breezy. They're perfect for the beach and the pool.

But here's the twist. Your toes have to grip just to keep them on, which changes how you walk, and with almost no arch support, it can lead to heel pain and sore feet! Podiatrists say save them for short walks and wear supportive shoes for long days. Flip flops also offer almost no protection if something falls on your toes.
